messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Curious who it was, I sneaked a little glance and my eyes almost fell out of my head.

output.original_text: Curious who it was, I sneaked a little glance and my eyes almost fell out of my head.
output.joy: Curious who it was, I sneaked a little glance and my eyes nearly popped out with excitement!
output.sadness: Curious who it was, I sneaked a little glance and felt a pang of disappointment as my eyes almost fell out of my head.
output.fear: Curious who it was, I sneaked a little glance and my eyes nearly bugged out in terror.
output.anger: Curious who it was, I sneaked a little glance, and I was so furious that my eyes almost popped out of my head!
output.surprise: Curious who it was, I sneaked a little glance and my eyes nearly fell out of my head in shock!
output.disgust: Curious who it was, I sneaked a little glance and my eyes almost fell out of my head in revulsion.
